dsp GenOrganGospelPercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.447214 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6326

organGospelPercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganGospelPercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.447214 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6747

dsp GenOrganFlutePlainChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 1.0 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6910

organFlutePercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganFlutePercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 1.0 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6910

organReedPlainChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganReedPlainChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.57735 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7325

organReedPercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganReedPercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.57735 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7313

dsp GenOrganTheatrePlainStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.5) * 0.408248 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7469

dsp GenOrganTheatrePercStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.5) * 0.408248 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7277

dsp GenOrganTheatrePercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.5) * 0.408248 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7488

organTheatrePercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganTheatrePercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.5) * 0.408248 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.8124

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))

    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))

organMellowPercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganMellowPercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 0.75) * 0.707107 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7542

dsp GenOrganBrightPlainStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.377964 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7970

dsp GenOrganBrightPlainTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.377964 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7990

dsp GenOrganBrightPercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.377964 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7829

organBrightPercChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganBrightPercChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 0.75 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.377964 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.8378

dsp GenOrganChurchPlainStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.25) * 0.447214 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7412

organChurchPercStill.source:
dsp GenOrganChurchPercStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.25) * 0.447214 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7131

organChurchPercTremolo.source:
dsp GenOrganChurchPercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 0.5 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 0.25 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 0.25) * 0.447214 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.7435

dsp GenOrganBassPlainTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.707107 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6833

dsp GenOrganBassPercStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.707107 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6805
